done: Built the manual foundations in Figma file 4OdxiJ5jvTf0SMYucdkwtK. No existing nodes were changed. The only new pages are 📘 Brand Manual (inserted as page 1) and 🧱 Knihovna (page 2).
Fonts: Baloo 2 (ExtraBold, Bold, SemiBold), Nunito and JetBrains Mono are all available, so no Inter fallback was needed.

Variables: 10 collections. primitives (41 hidden variables, with the client's final values): ink 800 #2C303C, ink 900 #242835, ink 600 #5A5F6E, mint/sky/lilac/blush 100/300/500/700 on the web pastels #A5EDC5 #9AD8F8 #C49CF2 #F5B8DC, mist #F5F4FB, paper #F6F4EF, the IG kit's dark canvas stops and the mascot colours. The 700 tones are AA on both mist and paper; mint 700 was darkened to #187C4C because the kit value #1B8A55 only reaches 3.99:1 on mist. color (41 semantic aliases, modes Web = paper, Social = mist, Dark = ink): bg, text, border, shadow/pop, glow, holo/holo-soft/holo-ink stop-1..4, doc/annotation. space (4 to 120), radius (12/20/28/40/pill), stroke, elevation, layout, format and safe zones, motion (durations and easing strings), type (modes Web/Social/Slides with font sizes and families). Every variable has scopes and WEB code syntax set.

Text styles (28): Display, H1 to H4, Body/L/M/S/Medium, Eyebrow, Caption, Button/L/S, Pill, Social/Headline/Text/Pill/Bingo, Doc/Chapter number, Doc/Chapter title, Doc/Slide title, Doc/Section, Doc/Card title, Doc/Lead, Doc/Body, Doc/Body S, Doc/Spec label, Doc/Code. Font size of the core styles is bound to the type/size/* variables.
Paint styles (10): Holo/Linear 115, Holo/Linear 90, Holo/Linear 180, Holo/Soft, Holo/Ink, Canvas/Dark, Glow/Mint/Sky/Lilac/Blush. Gradient stops are bound to variables.
Effect styles (8): Pop/S, Pop/L (hard 6 px shadow, colour and offset bound to shadow/pop and elevation), Pop/Accent, Shadow/Soft, Glow/Blob, Glow/Holo, Glow/Mascot, Glow/Text dark.

Components on 🧱 Knihovna: Logo (Primární / Světlá, official SVGs imported 1:1 as vectors), Jiskra (Holo / Ink / Mist, the curved web spark), Doc/Status badge (K potvrzení / Návrh / Schváleno / Vyřazeno), Slide/Header, Slide/Footer (variants Standard / K potvrzení), Slide/Base (1920x1080 on mist with the slide grid, title text and a boolean to hide it; header and footer are exposed instances), Slide/Chapter (dark divider with holo number and 3 rules under V kostce), Doc/Do-Dont card (Správně / Špatně), Doc/Swatch, Doc/Type specimen, Doc/Spec annotation (horizontal dimension / vertical dimension / callout), Doc/Clear space (X = 13.7 % of logo width, with a logo instance), Doc/Index tile.

On 📘 Brand Manual: 16 sections, 00 · Úvod to 15 · Ke stažení a správa značky, stacked vertically. Each section is 10400 wide and holds a grid of 5 slides per row, with room for the slide count in the outline.

Section 00 has the finished cover 00.00 (official light logo 1:1, mascot Mává undeformed with glow, title, claim 'Dodáme jiskru vašim sociálním sítím.', tagline sticker, footer with the K potvrzení badge for K21) and the index 00.01 (Slide/Base instance plus 16 Doc/Index tile instances with real chapter texts). A prototype flow 'Brand manuál' starts at the cover.
Czech rules applied: non-breaking spaces after one-letter prepositions and conjunctions and inside dates, no em or en dashes, the agency voice uses vy.

Checked with screenshots: library sections, the Slidy components, the Dokumentace components and the final cover all render correctly. The clear-space zone opacity was fixed after the first screenshot.
open: Recommended values I chose that still need the client's confirmation: slide backgrounds use mist (the outline default for the manual, while paper stays the web canvas), mint/sky/lilac/blush 500 tones, mint 700 #187C4C, Dark shadow/pop = lilac 300 (K07), and the swatch's default CMYK (a rough value until the ICC conversion, K29).

Not created (outline 4.5 or later phases, or other chapters' scope): Doc/Contrast pair, Doc/Callout, Doc/Token chip, Doc/Easing curve, Doc/Proportion bar, Doc/Download tile, Glow/Blob and Glow/Set components, Maskot/Bublina, UI/*, Icon/*, status colour variables (K33), the Story/Reel safe and A4 grids, the 1600x960 file thumbnail.

Prototype links are not wired yet: the 'Obsah' chip in the header and the index tiles need Navigate to targets. The chapter XX.00 slides do not exist yet, and a main component on the library page cannot link across pages, so each slide instance should get its links on the manual page.

The Logo component has only 2 variants. The chapter 03 agent should add Mono ink, Mono holo, Mono bílá and Symbol to the same set (200:4) rather than creating a new Logo. The old styles Sparkee/* on the file are still there. The outline plans to archive them; I did not touch them.

How other agents should build slides: create a 1920x1080 frame named like '03.04 · Logo · Ochranná zóna' inside the chapter section at x = 160 + (k % 5) * 2040, y = 160 + floor(k / 5) * 1200 (relative to the section). Put a Slide/Base instance at 0,0 as the locked bottom layer and set its header props (Číslo, Kapitola), footer props (Strana, Stav = K potvrzení where it applies) and Titulek. For XX.00 use a Slide/Chapter instance.
